picks.thesis: Company raised its just-ended September-quarter revenue to $18.5-19.5B from a $14.5-15.5B guide (+27% at the midpoint) and gross margin to 12-12.5% from 10.4-10.8%: a large estimate change, confirmed by the company. Big-name good-news gaps have paid over 5-10 days, so enter only if it reclaims VWAP and hold for days. Wrong if it falls back toward Tuesday's ~$32.5 close.
